$comment: The app's abbreviations, in one place. See src/lib/glossary.ts for why this is JSON and what the fields mean. `term` is matched case-insensitively and must be unique. `source` is shown as a credited link wherever the entry is rendered in full.

terms.long: The cluster of symptoms that shows up in the week or so before a period and clears once it starts — bloating, breast tenderness, mood dips, cravings, disturbed sleep. It sits in the luteal phase, when progesterone falls. It is common and it is not a diagnosis of anything.

The severe end of PMS, where the mood symptoms are disabling rather than annoying. Distinguished from PMS by severity and by how much it interferes with ordinary life. Worth raising with a clinician rather than tracking alone.

Your temperature at complete rest, taken first thing in the morning before getting out of bed, standing up or drinking anything. It matters because it steps up by roughly 0.3–0.5 °F (0.2–0.3 °C) just after ovulation and stays up until the next period — so the shift, not any single reading, is the signal. A reading taken after you are up is not a basal temperature.

The hormone whose surge triggers ovulation, usually 24–36 hours before the egg is released. Home ovulation tests detect this surge, which is why they predict ovulation while a temperature chart confirms it after the fact.

Cervical fluid changes texture across the cycle: sticky or absent after a period, then wetter, and around ovulation clear and stretchy like raw egg white. That stretchy stage is the most fertile sign available without a test.
The first day of your most recent period. Cycle day 1 is counted from it, and every phase estimate on this page is counted from it — not from the start of the calendar month.
Shorthand used in cycle-tracking communities for actively trying to get pregnant. It appears here only because you will meet it everywhere else.

How many days since ovulation, counted forward. Useful because the luteal phase — ovulation to period — is the more consistent half of the cycle for most people, typically 12–14 days, while the first half varies.

source.label: NHS · Fertility in the menstrual cycle

terms.long: A common hormonal condition that often makes cycles long, unpredictable or absent. If your logged cycles are consistently longer than 35 days or wildly irregular, that pattern is worth showing to a clinician — this app can show it, not explain it.

A four-question self-check used when an urge hits: am I hungry, angry, lonely or tired? The point is that an urge is usually carrying an unmet need underneath it, and naming the need is what makes the urge answerable with something other than willpower.
A self-help recovery programme built on cognitive-behavioural tools rather than a twelve-step framework — the source of the trigger-plan and urge-surfing ideas this page uses.

How hard a set or a session felt, on a 1–10 scale, where 10 is nothing left. It is the honest way to scale training on a day your logged numbers do not reflect how you slept — and unlike a percentage of your max, it needs no test to calibrate.
The heaviest weight you can lift once. Most programmes prescribe a percentage of it, and most apps estimate it from a heavier set of a few reps rather than asking you to attempt a true single.
A set taken to the most reps you can manage with good form, rather than to a prescribed number. Used as the last set of a progression to decide whether the next session goes up.
Start a prescribed set at the top of each minute and rest whatever is left of that minute. The clock, not you, decides the rest.

The soreness that arrives a day or two after unfamiliar work, peaks around 48 hours and fades. It tracks novelty far better than it tracks how useful the session was, so it is a poor measure of progress.

The rating system most pickleball leagues and tournaments use, on a roughly 2.0–8.0 scale, calculated from match results rather than self-assessment. This app tracks the number you tell it; it does not compute an official rating.
Everything you burn in a day — resting metabolism plus movement plus digestion — and therefore the number a calorie target is set against.
What you burn at complete rest keeping the lights on. The largest single part of TDEE, and the part you cannot change much day to day.
Eating within a restricted window each day — 16:8 means a 16-hour fast and an 8-hour eating window. The app's fasting timer tracks the window; the window is not itself a diet.
